schema.ModuloAventura5Rooms.premissa_e_g: Summary of the central conflict and the engagement hook
schema.ModuloAventura5Rooms.localizacao_: Name of the project's region or city (use [[Wikilink]])
schema.ModuloAventura5Rooms.tom_e_atmosf: Sensory mood and tone of the place
schema.ModuloAventura5Rooms.relogio_de_e: Consequence of delaying or taking a long rest
schema.ModuloAventura5Rooms.oponente_pri: Full statblock of the boss or antagonist
schema.Sala1Guardiao.ameaca_inicial: Guards, dangerous terrain or an entrance trap
schema.Sala2Enigma.narracao: Visual description of the puzzle or obstacle
schema.Sala2Enigma.natureza_desafio: Mechanism, runes, deadly chasm, abyss or puzzle
schema.Sala2Enigma.recompensa_de_sucesso: What they gain if they cleverly overcome the puzzle
schema.Sala3Reviravolta.narracao: Description of the scene where expectations are broken
schema.Sala3Reviravolta.a_reviravolta: The unexpected complication, betrayal, hostage or revelation
schema.Sala3Reviravolta.dilema_moral: The hard choice between two conflicting options
schema.Sala4Climax.titulo_sala: Name of the lair/chamber of the main fight
schema.Sala4Climax.narracao: Epic, oppressive description of the final confrontation
schema.Sala4Climax.efeito_ambiental_covi: Lair action triggering on initiative 20 every round
schema.Sala4Climax.interacao_dinamica: Scenery elements the players can destroy or use
schema.Sala4Climax.mapa_imagem: File name of the generated battlemap image
schema.Sala5Consequencias.tesouros: List of rewards (gold, magic items, documents)
schema.Sala5Consequencias.complicacao_fu: Danger or tension when trying to leave the dungeon
schema.Sala5Consequencias.evolucao_mundo: Positive and negative impact of the victory on the world
schema.Sala5Consequencias.gancho_futuro: Seed for the next adventure or a related place
schema.StatblockDND.ataque_principal: Name, bonus and damage of the main attack
schema.StatblockDND.habilidade_especial: Notable passive ability or innate magic
schema.TabelaResultadosD20.pericia_ou_at: Skill and ability tested (e.g. Survival (WIS), Arcana (INT))
schema.TabelaResultadosD20.ate_5_falha_c: Consequence for a roll <= 5: severe complication, damage, lost resource
schema.TabelaResultadosD20.de_6_a_10_fal: Consequence for a roll of 6 to 10: standard failure or success at a cost
schema.TabelaResultadosD20.de_11_a_15_su: Consequence for a roll of 11 to 15: normal operational success
schema.TabelaResultadosD20.de_16_a_20_ex: Consequence for a roll of 16 to 20: fast success with a tactical edge
schema.TabelaResultadosD20.acima_21_crit: Consequence for a roll of 21+: extraordinary revelation, shortcut or secret
schema.CompendioConhecimento.tema_entida: Name of the analyzed subject (e.g. 'Black Hammer Miners Guild')
schema.CompendioConhecimento.resumo_mest: One sentence summarizing what the Game Master must keep in mind when sharing this information.
schema.CompendioConhecimento.testes: Usually 1 to 3 applicable skills (e.g. History for politics, Investigation for urban secrets)
schema.FaixaResultadoLore.nivel_informac: E.g. Common Rumor, Basic Fact, Operational, Privileged Knowledge, Inner-Circle Secret
schema.FaixaResultadoLore.o_que_sabe: The exact, practical text the Game Master should narrate or read to the player.
schema.TesteDePericiaConhecimento.perici: E.g. History (INT), Investigation (INT), Nature (INT), Religion (INT), Arcana (INT) or Survival (WIS)
schema.TesteDePericiaConhecimento.foco_d: What this specific skill reveals about the entity (e.g. 'The Guild's origins and political alliances')
schema.TesteDePericiaConhecimento.faixas: The 5 or 6 result ranges, ordered from 5 up to 25+
schema.PersonaRoleplay.nome: Name of the character or entity
schema.PersonaRoleplay.titulo_ou_alcunha: E.g. The Silver Archmage, The Spore Witch, The Traitor Regent
schema.PersonaRoleplay.alinhamento_moral: E.g. Chaotic Good, Neutral Evil, Lawful Neutral
schema.PersonaRoleplay.ocupacao_ou_papel: What the character does in the world (e.g. Guildmaster, Royal Guard, Blacksmith)
schema.PersonaRoleplay.raca: E.g. Human, Moon Elf, Hill Dwarf, Half-Orc, Tiefling
schema.PersonaRoleplay.tom_de_pele: E.g. Marble-pale, Sun-tanned, Ash-grey with runes
schema.PersonaRoleplay.cabelo: E.g. Long, unkempt raven-black, Short silver with braids, Bald
schema.PersonaRoleplay.olhos: E.g. Piercing amber, Icy blue, Black without visible irises
schema.PersonaRoleplay.vestimentas_e_ace: Clothes, cloaks, armor, rings, necklaces or typical items worn
schema.PersonaRoleplay.tracos_marcantes: Scars, birthmarks, runic tattoos, burns or facial adornments
schema.PersonaRoleplay.psicologia_e_temp: How they think, react to provocation, their prejudices and emotional stance
schema.PersonaRoleplay.tom_de_voz_e_esti: E.g. Hoarse and slow voice, sarcastic and quick, solemn and whispering
schema.PersonaRoleplay.motivacao_primari: This character's great life goal or immediate ambition
schema.PersonaRoleplay.fraqueza_ou_medo_: What they fear, their psychological vulnerability or kept secret
schema.PersonaRoleplay.bordao_ou_frase_m: A typical sentence that sums up their worldview
schema.PersonaRoleplay.instrucoes_de_atu: Strict guidelines for the AI: how to act in discussions, what never to reveal at first...
schema.PersonaRoleplay.prompt_visual_ing: Complete descriptive prompt in ENGLISH, highly detailed for image generators (Flux / Stable Diffusion). It must describe the character's bust/portrait, focusing on face, hair, eyes, skin, emotional expression, upper clothing, dramatic rim lighting and a dark fantasy/concept art aesthetic.
schema.DocumentoFinalConsolidado.resumo_: Short note on how the Supreme Judge resolved the panels' conflicts
schema.DocumentoFinalConsolidado.conteud: Complete final canonical text formatted in Markdown with Callouts and Wikilinks
schema.FalaNPC.nome_npc: Name of the NPC mentioned in the document
schema.FalaNPC.reacao_primeira_pessoa: The NPC's first-person line and reaction to the proposed events
schema.RespostaEspecialistas.arquiteto: Structural expansion proposal: new facts, places or hooks
schema.RespostaEspecialistas.cronista: Audit against the world cache: consistency with dates, gods, factions and lore holes
schema.RespostaEspecialistas.falas_npcs: Reactions of each NPC mentioned in the text or affected by the subject
schema.RespostaEspecialistas.tatico_e_ca: Game mechanics (D&D skill DCs, hazards) combined with dramatic dilemmas and tensions
schema.RevisaoLore.aprovado: True if the text is 100% consistent with the lore; False if it needed corrections.
schema.RevisaoLore.critica: Short technical explanation of the inconsistencies found, or confirmation of compliance.
schema.RevisaoLore.texto_final: The COMPLETE Markdown content of the document. If approved, it must contain the full reviewed text, with no comments or opinions inside it.
schema.EntidadeCanon.nome: Official name of the entity, exactly as it must be used in every file
schema.EntidadeCanon.resumo_publico: What the players may know, in 1 to 3 sentences
schema.EntidadeCanon.segredo_do_mestre: What only the Game Master knows about it (empty if nothing)
schema.EntidadeCanon.eh_segredo: True if the very existence of the entity must stay hidden from the players
schema.EntidadeCanon.relacoes: Names of other entities linked to this one
schema.CanonCampanha.titulo: Short title of the campaign or arc
schema.CanonCampanha.premissa: The central idea in one paragraph
schema.CanonCampanha.visao_geral_publica: What the player characters know or can easily find out
schema.CanonCampanha.entidades: Every kingdom, place, person, faction, monster and adventure in the idea, with definitive names
schema.CanonCampanha.segredos_principais: The hidden truths of the campaign
schema.CanonCampanha.linha_do_tempo: Events in chronological order, from past to present
schema.Action.path: Path of the file or folder, starting from the project folder
schema.Action.objective: What this file must contain or what must change, citing the canon names
schema.Action.template: Template used when creating the file
schema.Action.segredo: True if the whole file must stay hidden from the players
schema.Action.fase: Phase: 1 world and kingdoms, 2 places and cities, 3 people and factions, 4 threats and monsters, 5 adventures and lore checks
schema.Action.genero: Genre of this file (one of the ids in the genre list); empty uses the project default
schema.Habilidade.nome: Name of the trait or action
schema.Habilidade.descricao: Full rule text (attack bonus, reach, damage, DC and effect)
schema.FichaCombate5e.nome: Name of the creature or NPC
schema.FichaCombate5e.armadura: Where the AC comes from (e.g. natural armor, chain mail)
schema.FichaCombate5e.dados_de_vida: Hit dice with the Constitution bonus (e.g. 6d8 + 12)
schema.FichaCombate5e.resistencias_e_imu: Resistances, immunities and vulnerabilities (empty if none)
schema.FichaCombate5e.nivel_de_desafio: Challenge Rating in SRD format: 0, 1/8, 1/4, 1/2 or 1 to 30
